Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the thorough outline and the mapping sheet; this is helpful. Quick answers up front, then next steps:

1) Required fields for onboarding form (we've also attached our standard form):
   - Company legal name + billing address
   - Primary procurement contact + email and phone
   - SOW reference number (if applicable) or DocuSign link
   - Line items (SKU, description, quantity, unit price, GL/ledger code)
   - Desired PO start/end dates and total commit
   - Cost center allocations (percentage or explicit amounts)

2) Timeline: once we receive the completed onboarding PDF + signed SOW (or approved PO request) we typically issue provisional PO numbers within 1 business day; final PO dispatch after procurement verification and cost-center tokening (usually same day).

3) Naming rules: keep SKU text <= 80 chars, avoid special characters (|, #, %), and include the short SKU code at the start (e.g., "1001 - FTL-Core"). That prevents our ledger normalization from creating duplicate entries.

Next steps for fastest turnaround:
- Please fill the attached Fleetline_Onboarding_Form.pdf with the fields above and return it to me.
- Update the LineItem_Mapping.xlsx with the exact ledger codes (89-OPS / 22-SLS) in the GL column.

I'll loop in Ben to confirm the spend cap split mechanics on our side. Once we have the completed form and the updated mapping sheet we'll create provisional PO numbers and share them back (we'll also attach them to the HubSpot record HS-112233).

Best,
